_comment: EarnControls' initial governed settings, in whole dollars (scaled by the reserve token's decimals at deploy). offeringCap is the one IV-03 §1.3 offering maximum of $1,000,000 across both products, by price paid: bond Purchase Prices and pool subscriptions together, rolls not counted (decision 38). holderCapFloor is decision 23's 7-day setting: a household may hold at most 10% of the greater of Pool Assets and this floor (decision 40). fundingLimit and poolCapacity are placeholders until the Holdings Board (Funding Limit) and the Lending Board (pool capacity) set them; fundingResolution is then that resolution's hash. Two FUNDING_ROLE holders post Lending Co.'s other indebtedness for borrowed money (decision 39).
